data.title: UPDATING and REPLACING Philadelphia Turns Up the Heat with its First-Ever Sweet Heat Cream Cheese in the United States in Partnership with Mike's Hot Honey®
data.description: In a news release dated September 15, 2026, it was announced that Philadelphia Mike’s Hot Honey Whipped Cream Cheese is now stocked at Walmart stores, with plans for nationwide retail availability by January 2027. The correction pertains to the exclusivity of the product at Walmart. Additionally, starting September 15, 2026, customers can purchase this product.

data.title: Ajax library workers reject two-tier contract: ‘We need a fair deal for everyone’
data.description: In the Town of Ajax, Ontario, library workers have decisively rejected a two-tier contract proposed by their Employer. During a "final offer" vote, full-time employees unanimously voted against the offer, with a 96.1% rejection by part-time staff. The voter turnout reached nearly 96%. Elaine Lievaart, acting President of CUP, expressed that the members' rejection highlights their opposition to the implementation of discriminatory work conditions within the organization.

data.title: Chip Stocks Break Through Ceiling As Sector Rebounds. Macom Is A Standout.
data.description: The SOX, or Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, experienced a fourth consecutive day of growth on Friday, driven by a surge in chip stocks. The sector rebounded strongly with a new wave of companies leading the charge. Among them, Macom stood out. This positive trend reflects a breakthrough for chip stocks as they broke through previous barriers in the market.

data.title: This Biotech Surged 50% On Positive Data In March. Now, It's Completely Gone.
data.description: Xenon Pharmaceuticals made the decision to pause enrollment in a few trials on Friday because of some unanticipated side effects, leading to the biotech company's stock plummeting to its lowest point in 10 months. Previously, the same company had experienced a significant surge of 50% in March following positive data. However, the recent developments have completely erased those gains.

data.title: Greenland Mines Applauds Historic U.S.-Denmark-Greenland Security Agreement, Reinforcing Greenland’s Strategic Importance to the United States
data.description: On September 18, 2026, Greenland Mines Ltd (Nasdaq: GRML) based in Charlotte, North Carolina, praised President Donald J. Trump for unveiling a significant security deal involving the United States, Denmark, and Greenland. The agreement, aimed at enhancing U.S. security in Greenland and preventing adversaries from setting up military bases or strategic investments, marks a pivotal move in safeguarding the long-term security of Greenland and the wider Arctic area. The collaboration sets the stage for an expanded and enduring U.S. security presence in Greenland, contributing to regional stability.

data.title: Par Health Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Two Lots of Dexmedetomidine HCl in 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection Due to the Presence of Particulate Matter
data.description: In Rochester, Michigan, on September 18, 2026, Par Health has initiated a voluntary recall of two lots of Dexmedetomidine HCl in 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection with a concentration of 400 mcg/100 mL (4 mcg/mL) at the hospital level. This recall is being conducted due to the identification of particulate matter in the product.

data.title: Fluence Energy Investigation Notice: Levi & Korsinsky Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into Fluence Energy (FLNC)
data.description: Fluence Energy's recent reports contain details about a continuous investigation by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission regarding the Company's revenue recognition and internal controls. data.title: Greenberg Traurig's Lori Cohen, Mathew Rosengart Named to Forbes' 2026 America's Top Lawyers List
data.description: Two attorneys from Greenberg Traurig, LLP, Lori G. Cohen and Mathew Rosengart, have recently been acknowledged as top lawyers in America by Forbes in 2026. Cohen, who serves as vice chair and co-chair of the Global Litigation Practice and Trial Practice Group at the firm, was highlighted for her exceptional legal expertise. This recognition underscores their high standing in the legal field in the current year.
